candidate.selection_reason: 1-bit PCX image data -> size validation -> prevents buffer overrun in monochrome decoding
candidate.source_summary: PCX image data from input buffer, specifically 1-bit monochrome images where each bit represents a pixel
candidate.sink_summary: state->buffer array accessed via state->buffer[state->x++] in the decoding loop, with potential memmove operations for band processing
candidate.guard_summary: Added check validates that xsize (image width in pixels) does not exceed buffer capacity (bytes * 8 bits per byte) for 1-bit mode; returns IMAGING_CODEC_OVERRUN error if violated
candidate.risk_pattern: 1-bit PCX images pack 8 pixels per byte; without validation, oversized width could cause buffer overflow during unpacking/shuffling operations
enclosing_conditions: existing bounds check at line 46 for state->x >= state->bytes
candidate.context_summary: Decoder processes PCX RLE-compressed data into image buffer; 1-bit mode requires special validation since pixels are packed 8 per byte
unresolved_facts: How state->bytes is calculated during PCX decoder initialization
Specific implementation of state->shuffle for 1-bit mode
Whether other image modes require similar validation

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
target_cwe.description: The product performs operations on a memory buffer, but it reads from or writes to a memory location outside the buffer's intended boundary. This may result in read or write operations on unexpected memory locations that could be linked to other variables, data structures, or internal program data.
remediation_steps: Use memory-safe programming practices and bounds checking
Implement proper resource management and cleanup
